title: Fine-Grained Action Segmentation for Renorrhaphy in Robot-Assisted Partial Nephrectomy
summary: Fine-grained action segmentation during renorrhaphy in robot-assisted partial nephrectomy requires frame-level recognition of visually similar suturing gestures with variable duration and substantial class imbalance. The SIA-RAPN benchmark defines this problem on 50 clinical videos acquired with the da Vinci Xi system and annotated with 12 frame-level labels. The benchmark compares four temporal models built on I3D features: MS-TCN++, AsFormer, TUT, and DiffAct. Evaluation uses balanced accuracy, edit score, segmental F1 at overlap thresholds of 10, 25, and 50, frame-wise accuracy, and frame-wise mean average precision. In addition to the primary evaluation across five released split configurations on SIA-RAPN, the benchmark reports cross-domain results on a separate single-port RAPN dataset. Across the strongest reported values over those five runs on the primary dataset, DiffAct achieves the highest F1, frame-wise accuracy, edit score, and frame mAP, while MS-TCN++ attains the highest balanced accuracy.
tldr: This paper introduces a fine‑grained action segmentation benchmark for renorrhaphy in robot‑assisted partial nephrectomy, comparing four temporal models on a dataset of 50 clinical da Vinci Xi videos with 12 frame‑level labels, where a diffusion‑based model (DiffAct) achieves the best performance across most metrics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对机器人辅助部分肾切除术中肾缝纫的细粒度动作分割基准，使用50个da Vinci Xi临床视频并标注12类帧级标签，比较了四种时序模型，其中基于扩散的DiffAct在大多数指标上表现最优。
summary_zh: 细粒度动作分割是在机器人辅助部分肾切除术中进行肾缝合术时，对视觉相似且持续时间可变的缝合手势进行帧级识别的过程，同时存在严重的类别不平衡问题。SIA-RAPN基准数据集在50个使用da Vinci Xi系统采集的临床视频上定义了这一问题，并标注了12个帧级标签。该基准数据集比较了基于I3D特征构建的四种时序模型：MS-TCN++、AsFormer、TUT和DiffAct。评估采用平衡准确率、编辑分数、重叠阈值为10、25和50时的段级F1、帧级准确率以及帧级平均精度均值。除了在SIA-RAPN数据集上针对五个发布划分配置的主要评估外，该基准数据集还在一个单独的单孔RAPN数据集上报告了跨域结果。在主要数据集上五次运行中报告的最优值中，DiffAct实现了最高的F1、帧级准确率、编辑分数和帧级平均精度均值，而MS-TCN++获得了最高的平衡准确率。

title: Benchmarking CNN- and Transformer-Based Models for Surgical Instrument Segmentation in Robotic-Assisted Surgery
summary:
Accurate segmentation of surgical instruments in robotic-assisted surgery is critical for enabling context-aware computer-assisted interventions, such as tool tracking, workflow analysis, and autonomous decision-making. In this study, we benchmark five deep learning architectures-UNet, UNet, DeepLabV3, Attention UNet, and SegFormer on the SAR-RARP50 dataset for multi-class semantic segmentation of surgical instruments in real-world radical prostatectomy videos. The models are trained with a compound loss function combining Cross Entropy and Dice loss to address class imbalance and capture fine object boundaries. Our experiments reveal that while convolutional models such as UNet and Attention UNet provide strong baseline performance, DeepLabV3 achieves results comparable to SegFormer, demonstrating the effectiveness of atrous convolution and multi-scale context aggregation in capturing complex surgical scenes. Transformer-based architectures like SegFormer further enhance global contextual understanding, leading to improved generalization across varying instrument appearances and surgical conditions.
  This work provides a comprehensive comparison and practical insights for selecting segmentation models in surgical AI applications, highlighting the trade-offs between convolutional and transformer-based approaches.
tldr: The study benchmarks five deep learning models (UNet, Attention UNet, DeepLabV3, SegFormer) for multi-class segmentation of surgical instruments in robotic-assisted radical prostatectomy videos, finding transformer-based SegFormer and DeepLabV3 comparable, and provides insights for selecting models in surgical AI applications.
tldr_zh: 该研究在机器人辅助根治性前列腺切除术视频中，对五种深度学习模型（UNet、Attention UNet、DeepLabV3、SegFormer）进行多类手术器械分割基准测试，发现基于变换器的SegFormer和DeepAlabV3性能相当，并为手术AI中的模型选择提供参考。
summary_zh: 在机器人辅助手术中准确分割手术器械对于实现上下文感知的计算机辅助干预至关重要，这些干预包括器械跟踪、工作流分析和自主决策。本研究在SAR-RARP50数据集上对五种深度学习架构（UNet、DeepLabV3、Attention UNet和SegFormer）进行了基准测试，用于对真实根治性前列腺切除术视频中的手术器械进行多类别语义分割。模型使用结合交叉熵和Dice损失的复合损失函数进行训练，以解决类别不平衡问题并捕获精细的物体边界。实验表明，虽然卷积模型（如UNet和Attention UNet）提供了强大的基准性能，但DeepLabV3取得了与SegFormer相当的结果，证明了空洞卷积和多尺度上下文聚合在捕获复杂手术场景中的有效性。基于Transformer的架构（如SegFormer）进一步增强了全局上下文理解能力，从而在不同的器械外观和手术条件下实现了更好的泛化效果。本研究为外科人工智能应用中分割模型的选择提供了全面的比较和实践指导，突出了卷积方法和基于Transformer方法之间的权衡。

title: A three-dimensional morphoelastic model for self-oscillations in polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments
summary: We introduce a three-dimensional model for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments operating in a fluid environment under an electric field. The formulation builds on a morphoelastic framework for inextensible and unshearable rods, such that the filament's activity is encoded in electric-field-induced spontaneous curvatures, while hydrodynamic interactions are captured via a local approximation of Stokes flows. We employ this framework to investigate the prototypical case of a filament with elliptic cross-section clamped at its base. Under a constant and uniform electric field aligned with its axis, the filament undergoes flutter instability beyond a critical field strength, as revealed by a linear stability analysis. Depending on the model parameters, the instability is characterized by either two- or three-dimensional self-sustained oscillations. We further examine this behaviour through numerical simulations in the post-critical regime, showing that flutter may develop into large amplitude planar oscillations or more complex three-dimensional motions, through a secondary bifurcation. Although the study represents a first step towards extending state-of-the-art models for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments to three dimensions, the richness of the resulting dynamics achievable under time-independent forcing underscores the potential of the proposed actuation mechanism for the design of biomimetic cilia and soft robotic systems.
tldr: A 3D morphoelastic rod model for polyelectrolyte hydrogel filaments under electric fields predicts flutter instability and self‑sustained planar or 3‑D oscillations, suggesting a new actuation mechanism for biomimetic cilia and soft robots.
tldr_zh: 该研究提出了一个三维形态弹性杆模型，用于描述聚电解质水凝胶纤维在电场作用下的行为，预测了颤振不稳定性和自维持的平面或三维振荡，为仿生纤毛和软体机器人的设计提供了新的驱动机制。
summary_zh:
摘要：
我们引入了一个用于聚电解质水凝胶丝的三维模型，该模型在电场作用下的流体环境中工作。该公式基于不可伸长且不可剪切杆的形态弹性框架，将丝的活动由电场诱导的自发曲率编码，而流体动力学相互作用则通过斯托克斯流的局部近似来捕捉。我们利用该框架研究了一个具有椭圆截面、底端固定的聚电解质水凝胶丝的典型情况。在沿丝轴方向的均匀恒定电场作用下，丝在超过临界电场强度时会发生颤振失稳，线性稳定性分析揭示了这一点。根据模型参数的不同，失稳表现为二维或三维自持振荡。我们进一步通过后临界状态的数值模拟研究了这种行为，表明颤振可能通过二次分岔发展为大幅平面振荡或更复杂的三维运动。虽然该研究是朝着将聚电解质水凝胶丝的最新模型扩展到三维方向迈出的第一步，但时不变驱动下所能实现的丰富动力学特性凸显了所提出的驱动机制在仿生纤毛和软体机器人系统设计中的潜力。

title: Sim-to-Real Transfer for Muscle-Actuated Robots via Generalized Actuator Networks
summary: Tendon drives paired with soft muscle actuation enable faster and safer robots while potentially accelerating skill acquisition. Still, these systems are rarely used in practice due to inherent nonlinearities, friction, and hysteresis, which complicate modeling and control. So far, these challenges have hindered policy transfer from simulation to real systems. To bridge this gap, we propose a sim-to-real pipeline that learns a neural network model of this complex actuation and leverages established rigid body simulation for the arm dynamics and interactions with the environment. Our method, called Generalized Actuator Network (GeAN), enables actuation model identification across a wide range of robots by learning directly from joint position trajectories rather than requiring torque sensors. Using GeAN on PAMY2, a tendon-driven robot powered by pneumatic artificial muscles, we successfully deploy precise goal-reaching and dynamic ball-in-a-cup policies trained entirely in simulation. To the best of our knowledge, this result constitutes the first successful sim-to-real transfer for a four-degrees-of-freedom muscle-actuated robot arm.
tldr: This paper presents GeAN, a neural network-based sim-to-real transfer method for muscle-actuated robots that learns actuation models from joint position trajectories without torque sensors, demonstrating successful policy transfer on a pneumatic artificial muscle robot (PAMY2) for goal-reaching and ball-in-a-cup tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出GeAN，一种基于神经网络的肌腱驱动机器人模拟到现实迁移方法，该方法无需扭矩传感器即可从关节位置轨迹学习驱动力模型，并在气动人工肌肉机器人PAMY2上成功实现了目标到达和杯中球等策略的迁移。
summary_zh: 肌腱驱动配合软体肌肉驱动能够实现更快、更安全的机器人，同时可能加速技能习得。然而，由于固有的非线性、摩擦和滞后特性，这些系统在实践中很少使用，因为这些特性使建模和控制变得复杂。到目前为止，这些挑战阻碍了策略从仿真到真实系统的迁移。为弥补这一差距，我们提出了一个仿真到现实的流程，通过学习这种复杂驱动的神经网络模型，并利用成熟的刚体仿真来模拟臂部动力学和与环境的交互。我们的方法称为广义执行器网络（Generalized Actuator Network，GeAN），它可以直接从关节位置轨迹学习，而无需力矩传感器，从而实现跨多种机器人的驱动模型辨识。通过在PAMY2（一种由气动人工肌肉驱动的肌腱驱动机器人）上使用GeAN，我们成功部署了完全在仿真中训练的精确目标到达和动态杯中球策略。据我们所知，这是首次成功实现四自由度肌肉驱动机械臂的仿真到现实迁移。
